name: PROP-M
about: PROP-M (1971-049, MOM), launched 1971 May 28. Its phases from GCAT: Mars, HCO. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Mars on GCAT's date); its perihelion 1.008 au and aphelion 1.465 au against GCAT's 1.010 and 1.500
